cleanIntro: Remington's Italian-language owner's manual is the only owner's manual the company publishes for the Versa Max, and it is a complete book: unload, barrel off, gas pistons out, trigger group and bolt out, bolt stripped to the head, then cleaning and reassembly. Two things about this shotgun are worth knowing before you start. The Versa Max runs TWO gas pistons in two cylinders, not one, and their caps take a 3/16-inch wrench that ships with the gun. And the bolt cam pin has an alignment indicator that must be lined up on reassembly — Remington states outright that a Versa Max missing that cam pin is not safe to use. Every step below carries the Italian sentence it came from and the page it is printed on, with an English rendering beside it.

steps.title: Safety ON — button fully right, red band gone
steps.action: Push the safety button fully across to the shooter's right. The red band must not be visible.
steps.prose: The red band is the whole indicator on this gun. Remington notes elsewhere in the same book that left-hand guns have the ON and OFF positions exactly reversed, so check the band rather than the direction of your thumb.
steps.quote: Inserire la sicura in posizione “ON” o “SAFE” spostando il pulsante relativo completamente alla destra del tiratore. La banda rossa NON sarà visibile.
steps.cite: Manuale d'uso — Libretto di istruzioni per: Remington® Versa Max™ Fucili semiautomatici — F404785_1 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Come scaricare l'arma da fuoco, step 2, p.14
steps.quoteEnglish: Put the safety in the "ON" or "SAFE" position by moving its button fully to the shooter's right. The red band will NOT be visible.
steps.warn: Always keep the firearm pointed in a safe direction.

steps.title: One shell at a time onto the carrier, then out of the chamber
steps.action: Press the shell latch to drop a shell from the magazine onto the carrier, then draw the charging handle fully rearward and take the shell out of the chamber.
steps.prose: This is a shell-by-shell unload, not a shake-it-out. Each press of the latch releases exactly one round from the magazine tube; the charging handle then extracts whatever is in the chamber.
steps.quote: Tirare la leva di armamento completamente all’indietro ed estrarre la cartuccia dalla camera di scoppio.
steps.cite: Manuale d'uso — Libretto di istruzioni per: Remington® Versa Max™ Fucili semiautomatici — F404785_1 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Come scaricare l'arma da fuoco, step 4, p.14
steps.quoteEnglish: Pull the charging handle fully rearward and extract the shell from the chamber.

steps.title: Repeat until the magazine is empty and the bolt locks open
steps.action: Keep repeating the latch-and-cycle until every shell is out. When the gun is empty the bolt stays locked to the rear on its own.
steps.prose: The bolt locking open is the gun telling you the magazine is empty. It is a useful signal and it is not a substitute for the look that comes next.
steps.quote: Ripetere le operazioni di cui alle fasi da 3 a 5 fino a che le cartucce siano rimosse dall’arma da fuoco.
steps.cite: Manuale d'uso — Libretto di istruzioni per: Remington® Versa Max™ Fucili semiautomatici — F404785_1 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Come scaricare l'arma da fuoco, step 6, p.14
steps.quoteEnglish: Repeat the operations in steps 3 to 5 until the shells have been removed from the firearm.

steps.title: Eyes on the chamber, the ejection port AND the magazine
steps.action: With the action fully open, visually check the chamber, the ejection port and the magazine and satisfy yourself the gun is completely empty and unobstructed.
steps.prose: Three places, one look each. Remington repeats this same sentence at the head of every procedure in the book that opens the gun — magazine cap, choke change, disassembly.
steps.quote: Con il caricatore completamente aperto, controllare visivamente la camera di scoppio, la finestra di espulsione e il caricatore per assicurarsi che l’arma sia completamente scarica.
steps.cite: Manuale d'uso — Libretto di istruzioni per: Remington® Versa Max™ Fucili semiautomatici — F404785_1 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Come scaricare l'arma da fuoco, step 7, p.14
steps.quoteEnglish: With the action fully open, visually check the chamber, the ejection port and the magazine to make sure the firearm is completely unloaded.

steps.title: How far this manual goes — and where it stops
steps.action: Everything below is what Remington publishes. The manual states that the Versa Max must NOT be taken further apart than it describes, except at the factory or by an authorised Remington service centre. Put safety glasses on before you start.
steps.prose: This is the manual bounding its own coverage, so it is worth reading as a limit rather than as boilerplate. It also means that if a Versa Max needs work past the bolt head, this book is not the document for it and no guide built from it can be.
steps.quote: ATTENZIONE: il fucile Versa Max NON deve essere smontato oltre quanto descritto in questo manuale, salvo che in fabbrica o da parte di un Centro di assistenza autorizzato Remington.
steps.cite: Manuale d'uso — Libretto di istruzioni per: Remington® Versa Max™ Fucili semiautomatici — F404785_1 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Come smontare l'arma per la pulizia — caution under the heading, p.18
steps.quoteEnglish: CAUTION: the Versa Max shotgun must NOT be disassembled beyond what is described in this manual, except at the factory or by an authorised Remington service centre.
steps.warn: Unload the firearm before cleaning. With the magazine removed, look into the chamber and the magazine to make sure there are no shells in the gun. Always wear safety glasses when disassembling and reassembling the firearm.

steps.title: Magazine cap off, anticlockwise
steps.action: Unscrew the magazine cap from the end of the magazine tube, turning it anticlockwise.
steps.prose: It should come off by hand. Keep it somewhere it cannot roll away — nothing forward of the receiver goes back on the gun without it.
steps.quote: Rimuovere il tappo del caricatore girandolo in senso antiorario.
steps.cite: Manuale d'uso — Libretto di istruzioni per: Remington® Versa Max™ Fucili semiautomatici — F404785_1 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Come rimuovere la canna, step 5, p.18
steps.quoteEnglish: Remove the magazine cap by turning it anticlockwise.

steps.title: Fore-end forward off the magazine tube
steps.action: Slide the fore-end forward off the magazine tube.
steps.prose: Forward and straight off. On a Versa Max the fore-end is not carrying an action bar the way a pump's is, so it comes away on its own once the cap is gone.
steps.quote: Rimuovere l’impugnatura anteriore dal tubo del caricatore facendola scivolare in avanti.
steps.cite: Manuale d'uso — Libretto di istruzioni per: Remington® Versa Max™ Fucili semiautomatici — F404785_1 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Come rimuovere la canna, step 6, p.18
steps.quoteEnglish: Remove the fore-end from the magazine tube by sliding it forward.

steps.title: Hold the barrel above the ring and pull it out of the receiver
steps.action: Take hold of the barrel above its ring and draw it forward out of the receiver.
steps.prose: Above the ring is where Remington tells you to hold it, and that is deliberate — grip it further forward and you are levering the barrel extension against the receiver instead of drawing it straight out.
steps.quote: Mantenendo la canna al di sopra dell’anello, tirarla fuori della carcassa.
steps.cite: Manuale d'uso — Libretto di istruzioni per: Remington® Versa Max™ Fucili semiautomatici — F404785_1 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Come rimuovere la canna, step 7, p.18
steps.quoteEnglish: Holding the barrel above the ring, pull it out of the receiver.

steps.title: Field strip complete
steps.action: Barrel, fore-end, magazine cap and receiver. That is the routine strip — enough to clean the bore, the chamber and the outside of the gas system. The gas pistons, trigger group and bolt come out in the deep clean.
steps.prose: Keep the oil light from here. Remington's lubrication instruction for this gun is a single line and it says a small quantity is what prevents rust — more is not better on a gas gun.
steps.quote: Una lubrificazione eccessiva deve essere sempre evitata. L’applicazione di una piccola quantità d’olio RemTM aiuta ad evitare la ruggine.
steps.cite: Manuale d'uso — Libretto di istruzioni per: Remington® Versa Max™ Fucili semiautomatici — F404785_1 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Lubrificazione, p.18
steps.quoteEnglish: Excessive lubrication must always be avoided. Applying a small quantity of Rem™ oil helps prevent rust.

deepSteps.title: Both gas cylinder caps off with the 3/16 wrench
deepSteps.action: With the barrel out of the receiver, unscrew BOTH gas cylinder caps anticlockwise using the 3/16-inch wrench supplied with the gun.
deepSteps.prose: Both, not one — the Versa Max runs a pair of pistons in a pair of cylinders and that is the point of the design. The wrench came in the box; a screwdriver across the cap flats will round them.
deepSteps.quote: Con la canna rimossa dalla carcassa, rimuovere entrambi i tappi dei cilindri di sottrazione del gas girandoli in senso antiorario con una chiave da 3/16 fornita con la confezione.
deepSteps.cite: Manuale d'uso — Libretto di istruzioni per: Remington® Versa Max™ Fucili semiautomatici — F404785_1 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Come rimuovere i pistoni del gas, step 8, p.18
deepSteps.quoteEnglish: With the barrel removed from the receiver, remove both gas cylinder caps by turning them anticlockwise with the 3/16 wrench supplied in the package.

deepSteps.title: Pistons out of the MUZZLE end of the gas block
deepSteps.action: Slide the two gas pistons out of the muzzle end of the gas block.
deepSteps.prose: They come out forward. Note which way round each one sits before it leaves the block — they go back small end first, and Remington says so explicitly in the reassembly section.
deepSteps.quote: Rimuovere i pistoni del gas dall’estremità della bocca del blocco del gas.
deepSteps.cite: Manuale d'uso — Libretto di istruzioni per: Remington® Versa Max™ Fucili semiautomatici — F404785_1 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Come rimuovere i pistoni del gas, step 9, p.18
deepSteps.quoteEnglish: Remove the gas pistons from the muzzle end of the gas block.

deepSteps.title: Let the bolt down under control before the trigger group moves
deepSteps.action: Hold the charging handle, press the bolt release, and ride the bolt slowly forward.
deepSteps.prose: Slowly and under your hand. Letting a Versa Max bolt slam home on an empty chamber with the barrel out is how breech faces and bolt heads get marked, and the trigger group will not come out with the bolt back anyway.
deepSteps.quote: Tenendo la leva di armamento, spingere il pulsante di rilascio dell’otturatore, quindi lasciar muovere lentamente il caricatore in avanti.
deepSteps.cite: Manuale d'uso — Libretto di istruzioni per: Remington® Versa Max™ Fucili semiautomatici — F404785_1 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Come rimuovere il gruppo del grilletto, step 10, p.19
deepSteps.quoteEnglish: Holding the charging handle, press the bolt release button, then let the action move slowly forward.

deepSteps.title: Trigger plate pin out with a punch
deepSteps.action: Drift the trigger plate pin out of the receiver with light taps of a punch.
deepSteps.prose: Light taps. One pin holds the whole fire control in a Versa Max, and it is a push fit — if it is fighting you, the bolt is not fully forward.
deepSteps.quote: Far uscire il perno del ponticello dando leggeri colpi con un punzone.
deepSteps.cite: Manuale d'uso — Libretto di istruzioni per: Remington® Versa Max™ Fucili semiautomatici — F404785_1 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Come rimuovere il gruppo del grilletto, step 11, p.19
deepSteps.quoteEnglish: Drive the trigger plate pin out with light taps of a punch.

deepSteps.title: Bolt release pressed, trigger group down and out
deepSteps.action: Press the bolt release and at the same time pull the trigger group downward out of the receiver.
deepSteps.prose: The bolt release has to be held in while the group comes down — it is what clears the linkage. Pulling straight down without it binds the group in the receiver.
deepSteps.quote: Rimuovere il ponticello dalla carcassa, spingendo il pulsante di rilascio dell’otturatore e tirando il ponticello verso il basso, fuori della carcassa.
deepSteps.cite: Manuale d'uso — Libretto di istruzioni per: Remington® Versa Max™ Fucili semiautomatici — F404785_1 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Come rimuovere il gruppo del grilletto, step 12, p.19
deepSteps.quoteEnglish: Remove the trigger group from the receiver by pressing the bolt release button and pulling the trigger group downward, out of the receiver.

deepSteps.title: Charging handle out, then the bolt forward out of the receiver
deepSteps.action: With the bolt fully forward and the barrel and trigger group already out, pull the charging handle straight out of the bolt, then slide the bolt assembly forward out of the receiver.
deepSteps.prose: The order matters and Remington states it: barrel and trigger group first, then the handle, then the bolt. The handle is a plug — it will not come out with the bolt anywhere but fully forward.
deepSteps.aside: Then: remove the bolt assembly from the receiver by sliding it forward.
deepSteps.quote: Con l’otturatore completamente in avanti, la canna e il ponticello rimossi, tirare la leva di armamento fuori dell’otturatore.
deepSteps.cite: Manuale d'uso — Libretto di istruzioni per: Remington® Versa Max™ Fucili semiautomatici — F404785_1 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Come rimuovere il gruppo dell'otturatore, step 13, p.19
deepSteps.quoteEnglish: With the bolt fully forward and the barrel and trigger group removed, pull the charging handle out of the bolt.

deepSteps.title: Firing pin retaining pin — the spring behind it is compressed
deepSteps.action: Hold the firing pin in place with one hand and pull the retaining pin out of the bolt with the other. Safety glasses on for this one.
deepSteps.prose: Remington gives this its own warning because the firing pin spring is under compression behind that pin. Let go and it launches. Hold the pin, then remove the retainer, then release slowly.
deepSteps.quote: Tenendo il percussore in posizione, rimuovere il perno di fissaggio tirandolo fuori dell’otturatore.
deepSteps.cite: Manuale d'uso — Libretto di istruzioni per: Remington® Versa Max™ Fucili semiautomatici — F404785_1 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Come rimuovere il gruppo dell'otturatore, step 15, p.19
deepSteps.quoteEnglish: Holding the firing pin in place, remove the retaining pin by pulling it out of the bolt.
deepSteps.warn: Use extreme caution when removing the firing pin and its retainer, because it is under compression. Wear safety glasses to avoid serious personal injury.

deepSteps.title: Firing pin and spring out the back, cam pin out, bolt head off
deepSteps.action: Take the firing pin and its spring out of the rear of the bolt body, turn the bolt over to remove the cam pin, then pull the bolt head out of the body.
deepSteps.prose: That is the end of the published strip. Four pieces — body, head, cam pin, firing pin and spring — and Remington documents nothing beyond them.
deepSteps.aside: Then: turn the bolt assembly over to remove the cam pin, and pull the bolt head out of the bolt body.
deepSteps.quote: Rimuovere il percussore e la relativa molla dalla parte posteriore del gruppo dell’otturatore.
deepSteps.cite: Manuale d'uso — Libretto di istruzioni per: Remington® Versa Max™ Fucili semiautomatici — F404785_1 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Come rimuovere il gruppo dell'otturatore, step 16, p.19
deepSteps.quoteEnglish: Remove the firing pin and its spring from the rear of the bolt assembly.

deepSteps.title: Trigger group is cleaned as one piece — do not take it apart
deepSteps.action: Spray Rem Action Cleaner into the trigger group where the manual's illustration shows, blow it dry with compressed air or let it air dry, then work the trigger several times and confirm it returns fully forward every time.
deepSteps.prose: Assembled, always. And the trigger-return check is a pass/fail, not a formality: Remington states that a trigger which does not return fully forward every time means the gun is NOT in safe working condition and must not be used until an authorised service centre has looked at it.
deepSteps.quote: ATTENZIONE: pulire il gruppo del grilletto come un tutt’uno. Non smontarlo.
deepSteps.cite: Manuale d'uso — Libretto di istruzioni per: Remington® Versa Max™ Fucili semiautomatici — F404785_1 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Come pulire il gruppo del grilletto — caution under the heading, p.20
deepSteps.quoteEnglish: CAUTION: clean the trigger group as a single unit. Do not disassemble it.

deepSteps.title: Cam pin back in with its indicator on the bolt centreline
deepSteps.action: Seat the bolt head in the body, insert the cam pin, and line the cam pin's indicator up with the centreline of the bolt.
deepSteps.prose: There is an alignment mark on the cam pin and it exists to be used. Remington says plainly that a Versa Max whose bolt body has no cam pin in it is NOT safe to use — this is the step that decides whether the gun you reassemble is a shotgun or a hazard.
deepSteps.quote: Inserire il perno della camma nell’otturatore. Allineare l’indicatore del perno della camma alla linea centrale dell’otturatore.
deepSteps.cite: Manuale d'uso — Libretto di istruzioni per: Remington® Versa Max™ Fucili semiautomatici — F404785_1 (RemArms' own part code for this book; no form number or revision code is printed inside the document) — Come rimontare il gruppo dell'otturatore, step 2, p.22
deepSteps.quoteEnglish: Insert the cam pin into the bolt. Align the cam pin's indicator with the centreline of the bolt.
deepSteps.warn: When the bolt cam pin is not in the bolt body, the firearm is NOT in a safe condition to be used.

cleaning.name: BARREL, CHOKE & LOCKING RECESS
tasks: Wet a patch with Brite Bore or an equivalent and run it through the bore from the chamber end to the muzzle several times, taking out residue and dirt
Fit the correct-gauge brush to the rod, spray it with Brite Bore and push it through the bore several times
Swap back to patches, a fresh one each pass, until one comes out with no dirt on it
Clear all firing residue out of the barrel's locking recess and off the ejector
Take the choke out, brush its threads and the matching barrel threads clean, then dry them and apply a light film of Rem Oil to both before the choke goes back
Confirm the barrel and chamber are free of obstructions before the gun is reassembled

cleaning.name: GAS BLOCK, PISTONS & O-RINGS (deep only)
tasks: Spray the gas block, the gas caps and both gas pistons with Brite Bore or an equivalent and brush the firing residue off
Dry with compressed air or let them air dry
Inspect the gas cap O-rings for wear and REPLACE them if they are worn — this is an inspection with a verdict, not a look
Run a Rem Oil patch through the barrel including the gas block, then a dry one to take the excess back out
Wipe a small amount of Rem Oil onto the outside of the barrel, the pistons and the O-rings

cleaning.name: BOLT, TRIGGER GROUP & RECEIVER (deep only)
tasks: Spray the whole bolt assembly with Rem Action Cleaner and brush it if it needs it, then dry and apply a light film of Rem Oil
Clean the trigger group AS ONE UNIT — do not take it apart

After cleaning the trigger group, work the trigger repeatedly and confirm it returns fully forward every single time; if it does not, the gun is not safe to use until an authorised service centre has inspected it
Cycle the safety fully ON and fully OFF several times — it must not stop anywhere between SAFE and FIRE
Spray and wipe every component inside the receiver with Rem Action Cleaner, dry it thoroughly, then apply a light film of Rem Oil inside and out
Take off every trace of excess lubricant with a clean dry patch

reassembly: Safety glasses on — Remington requires them for reassembly as well as disassembly.
Seat the bolt head in the bolt body, aligning the cam pin hole in the head with the matching slot in the body.
Fit the cam pin with its indicator on the centreline of the bolt, then the firing pin spring over the firing pin, the firing pin in through the rear, and the retaining pin fully home.
Fit the gas pistons small end first into the top of the gas cylinders, then screw the gas caps in clockwise — do not overtighten.
Slide the bolt assembly into the front of the receiver, strut first, and check the strut engages the recoil spring thimble at the rear of the receiver.
Push the charging handle into the bolt until it engages its detent.
Make sure the hammer is cocked before the trigger group goes in — if it is not, rotate it fully rearward until the trigger holds it.
Press the bolt release, fit the trigger group into the receiver and refit its pin.
Fit the barrel with the bolt held open, then the fore-end, then the magazine cap.
fncheck: Remington prints its own procedure — "Come provare il funzionamento dell'arma", from printed page 22 — and the manual's own trigger and safety checks are the load-bearing part of it. With the gun confirmed empty: work the trigger repeatedly with your thumb on the hammer and the safety off, and the trigger must return fully forward every time. Remington's warning, verbatim: "ATTENZIONE! Se il grilletto non ritorna completamente in avanti ogni volta che viene rilasciato, l’arma NON è in condizione di funzionamento sicuro e NON deve essere usata prima di essere ispezionata da un centro di assistenza autorizzato Remington." — in our English, "WARNING! If the trigger does not return fully forward every time it is released, the firearm is NOT in safe working condition and must NOT be used before being inspected by an authorised Remington service centre." Then, with the hammer cocked, cycle the safety fully ON and fully OFF several times; it must not rest anywhere between SAFE and FIRE. And before the gun is fired, confirm the cam pin is in the bolt body — the manual states a Versa Max without it is not safe to use.
